SELECT
    f.sale_id,
    f.sale_date,
    f.amount,
    f.quantity,
    f.discount_pct,
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.email        AS customer_email,
    c.region,
    c.segment,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name,
    p.category,
    p.sub_category,
    p.unit_price,
    d.date_key,
    d.calendar_date,
    d.month_name,
    d.quarter,
    d.fiscal_year,
    s.store_id,
    s.store_name,
    s.city,
    s.country
FROM dbo.fact_sales f
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_customer  c ON f.customer_id  = c.customer_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_product   p ON f.product_id   = p.product_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_date      d ON f.date_key      = d.date_key
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_store     s ON f.store_id      = s.store_id
WHERE
    f.sale_date >= DATEADD(DAY, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))
    AND f.is_deleted = 0
    AND c.is_active  = 1

SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.customer_name,
    c.email,
    c.phone,
    c.date_of_birth,
    c.registration_date,
    c.segment,
    a.address_id,
    a.address_line1,
    a.city,
    a.state,
    a.zip_code,
    a.country,
    o.total_orders,
    o.total_spend,
    o.avg_order_value,
    o.last_order_date,
    lv.loyalty_tier,
    lv.loyalty_points
FROM dbo.dim_customer c
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_address      a  ON c.address_id    = a.address_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.agg_order_stats  o  ON c.customer_id   = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN dbo.dim_loyalty      lv ON c.customer_id   = lv.customer_id
WHERE c.is_active = 1

SELECT
    i.item_id,
    i.item_name,
    i.sku,
    i.upc_code,
    w.warehouse_id,
    w.warehouse_name,
    w.region       AS warehouse_region,
    s.supplier_id,
    s.supplier_name,
    inv.quantity_on_hand,
    inv.quantity_reserved,
    inv.quantity_available,
    inv.reorder_level,
    inv.reorder_quantity,
    inv.unit_cost,
    inv.snapshot_date
FROM dbo.fact_inventory inv
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_item      i ON inv.item_id      = i.item_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_warehouse w ON inv.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_supplier  s ON inv.supplier_id  = s.supplier_id
WHERE inv.snapshot_date = DATEADD(WEEK, -1, CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))

SELECT
    gl.ledger_id,
    gl.transaction_date,
    gl.amount,
    gl.debit_credit_flag,
    gl.description,
    acc.account_id,
    acc.account_code,
    acc.account_name,
    acc.account_type,
    cc.cost_center_id,
    cc.cost_center_name,
    cc.department,
    e.entity_id,
    e.entity_name,
    e.legal_entity
FROM dbo.fact_gl_transactions gl
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_account     acc ON gl.account_id     = acc.account_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_cost_center cc  ON gl.cost_center_id = cc.cost_center_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_entity      e   ON gl.entity_id      = e.entity_id
WHERE
    MONTH(gl.transaction_date) = MONTH(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))
    AND YEAR(gl.transaction_date)  = YEAR(DATEADD(MONTH, -1, GETDATE()))

SELECT
    e.employee_id,
    e.first_name,
    e.last_name,
    e.email,
    e.hire_date,
    e.termination_date,
    e.employment_status,
    d.department_id,
    d.department_name,
    d.division,
    j.job_id,
    j.job_title,
    j.job_level,
    j.job_family,
    l.location_id,
    l.office_name,
    l.city,
    l.country
FROM dbo.dim_employee e
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_department d ON e.department_id = d.department_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_job        j ON e.job_id        = j.job_id
INNER JOIN dbo.dim_location   l ON e.location_id   = l.location_id
WHERE e.employment_status IN ('Active','On Leave')
